decision.summary: A quasi-stable interval in E and U (610–622) is observed: E stays low (≈-1.3 to -1.9), U elevated (≈2.2–4.0), while N varies. A sharp E drop occurs at 623 (to -3.7), but no clear opposing return is resolved within allowed context [575,660]; thus the temporary offset status remains uncertain. No other temporary intervals meet criteria for confirmed status.

intervals.observation: E remains near -1.3 to -1.9 and U elevated (~2.2–4.0) from index 610 to 622; N fluctuates moderately. This plateau contrasts with prior high-frequency variability. No opposing return observed after the sharp E drop at 623, so return is unconfirmed.
